findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following nonfood contact surfaces are observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. FIRST REPEAT- The deli walk-in cooler fan covers. 
2. The walk-in cooler fan covers in the meat room and the walk-in coolers on both sides of the meat department room. 
3. There is a large chunk of ice on the wall of the seafood department walk-in cooler. Ensure that this ice is removed and any issues are repaired to allow the wall to be smooth and easily cleanable. 

Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: There is a drain in the seafood department that is not draining any waste water. The PIC of this department stated that they squeegee the water to another drain due to the drain not draining. The PIC also stated that they have not noticed any sewage backing up. There has been a ticket put in for this issue, but the issue has not yet been repaired. A follow up is scheduled for 1/13/2026 (allows the store another day to get a company to come repair the drain) to ensure that the drain has been fixed and is sufficiently allowing waste water to drain.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The top of the knife holder in the deli department was observed to be have food debris and soil residue on it. CORRECTED- The PIC cleaned it during the inspection and was educated on the importance of maintaining this clean. Ensure that food contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.comment: There were single service containers in the deli that were observed to not be inverted. CORRECTED- The PIC inverted the containers and was educating on keeping single service articles and utensils inverted to protect the food contact surface from contamination. Ensure that all single service articles and utensils are handled, displayed, and dispensed to prevent contamination to food and lip-contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-904.11(A) Kitchenware and Tableware. (A) SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of FOOD- and lip-contact surfaces is prevented.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed no paper towels at on of the deli hand sinks. Ensure paper towels are provided at every hand sink so employees can wash hands properly. Paper towels were provided during the inspection. 

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Observed food containers stacked with no barrier between the food and the container bottom. The bottom of the container is not considered a clean and sanitized surface. Ensure a barrier is placed between containers to prevent contamination. The items were separated during the inspection. 

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
A butcher area hand sink was observed with a piece of equipment and a cleaning sponge in it. The hand sink may only be used for hand washing. The items were removed from the hand sink. 

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
A quat spray bottle in the deli and a sani bucket in the butcher area was observed with a concentration of 0ppm. Quat solutions must be maintained between 200ppm and 400ppm. The sanitizing solutions were changed during the inspection to correct the violation. 

4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment: 3-501.17: Observed two bags of cooked chicken in cooler in deli to not be marked with a prepared/use by date. Bags of chicken were labeled with today’s date. (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment: 3-305.11: Observed a cup with no handle used as a scoop in container of chicken seasoning in deli kitchen. (A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor. (B) FOOD in working containers and packages may be stored less than 6 inches on case lot handling EQUIPMENT. (C) Pressurized BEVERAGE containers, cased FOOD in waterproof containers, and milk containers in plastic crates may be stored on floor.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed sanitizing solution in sanitizer bucket in meat department to test at 0 ppm quaternary ammonia.  Santizing solution at proper concentration must be available for use during food preparation.  Bucket that tested at 200 ppm quaternary ammonia made upon request.  4-501.114 Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. 
A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under ¶4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, P and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: 
(1) Have a minimum temperature of 24oC (75oF), P
(2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, P and 
(3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions;P
